name: navigation/tab-bar
title: Tab bar
description: Tabs with an indicator that glides to the selected tab.

files.content:
export { Tab, TabBar, TabPanel, Tabs } from './TabBar';
export type { TabBarProps, TabPanelProps, TabProps, TabsProps } from './TabBar';

keyboard.action: Move focus to the next tab (wraps to the first).
Move focus to the previous tab (wraps to the last).
Move focus to the first tab.
Move focus to the last tab.
Move from the selected tab into its panel.

notes: Follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern: `tablist`, `tab` and `tabpanel`, with `aria-selected`, `aria-controls` and `aria-labelledby` wired up.
Only the selected tab is in the Tab order (roving tabindex); arrow keys move between tabs.
Each panel is focusable, so keyboard users can reach panels that have no focusable content.
Right-to-left layouts reverse the arrow keys.
In forced-colours mode the indicator uses the system highlight colour and the selected label is underlined.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The indicator jumps to the selected tab instead of gliding, and panels appear without the short fade.
